title: add: copy --parents leaking host directories
body:
<!--

Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines

#### What type of PR is this?

<!--
Please label this pull request according to what type of issue you are
addressing, especially if this is a release targeted pull request.

Uncomment only one `/kind <>` line, hit enter to put that in a new line, and
remove leading whitespace from that line:
-->

> /kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
The tar filter skip check compared dir names without trailing slashes against tar.Header.Name values that always have one, so it never matched. Every ancestor dir above the `/./` pivot point leaked into the image except the one caught by an unrelated fallback.

Also fix `copy --parents`: it called `parse_table` which doesn't exist in this repo, so the test silently never ran, replaced with a plain array loop, it now regression tests this leak

#### How to verify it
`sudo bats -f "copy --parents" tests/copy.bats"`
#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
`bats -f "copy --parents"` was a no op because the `parse_table` function did not exist so it passed regardless

Fixed bug where --parents would leak host or build context ancestor directories when using buildah copy --parents or COPY --parents into the built image as real directory entries
